data.gender_notes: Samruddhi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Samruddhi means 'Prosperity, Growth'. It is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that is derived from the word 'Samruddha' which means 'Expansive, Wide-ranging'. The name Samruddhi signifies abundance and prosperity in all areas of life. It is a name that inspires growth, success, and abundance. The name Samruddhi carries the meaning “Prosperity, Growth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Samruddhi usually hope their child will grow to embody prosperity, growth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Samruddhi is a name that represents the spiritual qualities of expansiveness, generosity, and abundance. It is believed to bring prosperity and growth not just in material aspects but also in spiritual and emotional growth.
data.etymology: Samruddhi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prosperity, Growth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samruddhi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name Samruddhi reflects these cultural values and ideals, encouraging individuals to living fulfilling and prosperous lives.
